qz_i: Five questions, no right answers. Just the truth about you.
qz1: Friday night in Vice City, what do you do?
qz1a: I go out, and I pick where.
qz1b: I work. Someone has to pay rent.
qz1c: I stay home listening to police frequencies.
qz2c: An old sedan nobody looks at twice.
qz3c: I saw it coming. Plan B.
qz3d: I floor it. Make or break.
qzL: You know what you want, and you never let anyone decide for you.
qzJ: Loyal and solid, ready to do anything for your people, even the worst ideas.
qzC: Nobody fools you. You see everything coming before anyone else.
qzR: The big score, the style, and a smile on the way out.
